desc: **Task 1 (derivation):** Non-crossing matching reformulation; even block value g(B) = 2·top_{|B|/2}(B) − sum(B) is achievable (sign-assignment + adjacent opposite-sign deletion argument); odd N ⇒ survivor at odd 1-indexed position splitting into two independent even blocks.

**Task 2+3 (implement):** Full solution written: `sys.stdin.buffer` input, `topsum_prefix` two-heap (median-maintenance) structure with `sum_high` updated on every push/pop, even branch prints `pre[N]`, odd branch maximizes `pre[i-1]+suf[N-i]` over odd i using the reversed-array prefix.

**Task 4 (validation):** Hand-verified all three samples (5, 14, 0), heap trace verified for k=1..4 (res[2]=|A1−A2|, res[4]=5 on sample 1), and edge cases N=2 (even branch → |A1−A2|) and N=3 (max of |A1−A2|, |A2−A3|) confirmed correct.
**Task 5 (perf):** O(N log N) with two C-level heapq passes plus an O(N) scan over odd survivor positions — comfortably within limits for N = 3·10⁵; Python big ints handle sums up to ~3·10¹⁴.
